craft_notes: Sthāyin: burning to first throb. Rows: burn, mount, form, plant. Rejected: softening the burn — killed: burning is the rite. Read aloud: kindling to form.

lines: Thus standing, facing northward sit, consuming body-hood
in frame, bulk, fire-pit and such, by non-ego-forgoing;
then near as strides another's frame, from disembodiedness —
through mounting the unwavering, blazing-seat, which comes ghost-like
to the point of the first vibration — this alone is form;
thereupon as taught is the worship-cakra of the gods;
chiefly here to be worshipped are the Shaktis.
l4.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ sthite uttarābhimukham upaviśya dehapuryaṣṭakādau ahambhāvatyāgena dehatāṃ dahet saṃnidhāv api paradehavat adehatvāt tato nistaraṅgadhruvadhāmarūḍhasya dṛṣṭisvābhāvyāt yā kila ādyā spandakalā saiva mūrtiḥ tadupari yathopadiṣṭayājyadevatācakranyāsaḥ prādhānyena ca iha śaktayo yājyāḥ
